name: key-dates-list
title: Key dates list
description: Term dates, deadlines and closures as a clear list of dates and ranges, with the next one marked in words.
docs: Dates are calendar days, sorted by their first day; a range is written once with both ends in time elements. Pass today as an ISO date for stable rendering, otherwise the current day in timeZone is used. groupBy is month, term (each date names its term) or none, and calendar is a slot for an Add to calendar link on each row. A day-first locale such as en-GB writes 24 Dec, a month-first one Dec 24. labels translates the markers. The layout follows the width of its column, not the screen: dates, labels and types sit in three columns from 672px, the month or term moves beside its rows from 896px, and below that each date stacks.
